name: win-owa-widget
description: Exchange / OWA meetings in the Windows tray: timeline, one-click join, reminders, RSVP
author: Dmitry Borovskiy

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node scripts/build-main.mjs && vite build
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --win nsis --arm64 --config electron-builder.arm64.yml --publish never
